name: WALKING SANYA HOME SIMULATOR
source:
Walking Sanya Home Simulator was made in 2020 by [url=/p22161]me[/url] and a friend who decided to stay anonymous. It's cursed fanfiction in visual novel form.

Walk Sanya home and be a gentleman... and maybe you'll survive.

[From [url=https://www.tumblr.com/nopanamaman/725219825725652992/walkingsanyahomesim-10-pczip]Tumblr[/url]]
